first_attempt_end.basis: final result; no predicted_death cutoff recorded

limitations: 自有与外部独立分母；游戏版本自有未记录，保持unknown，不能称v0.111精确对照。
进阶分列；采用冻结外部模型回分，未再拟合或由开发定义流派。终局簇含结局信息。
自有结果是最终记录结果；SL重试/预判必死证据另分层，未见重试证据不等于证明未SL。首次尝试截止代理另记，不把最终牌组当首次失败牌组。
逐层/改牌快照是真实日志决策点；中间缺帧未知，首次记录到不等于实际首次获得。
战斗沿原logdb视图：first combat frame为首记录帧，未必动作前；SL同层可能合并尝试，触及战斗不据合并数据计算单次HP损失。
防御仅同一固定目录正block牌副本代理；间接防御、未知ID和历史版本对齐不补造。
外部前节点HP、还原时间线与自有逐层快照口径不完全等价；ordinal不是已核floor，不相减解释成晚几层。
关联与样本差异不证明因果；自有代码/大脑/学习版本演变、SL、玩家选择和幸存偏差保留。
question_scope: 原logdb抽取的题型/选项/选择/理由（可能已按原抽取器截长），不是全部原生prompt；off/len可定位冻结源行。

rows.archetype: Flexible damage-first Silent with relic-supported scaling and reliable defense
rows.summary: Draft efficient damage and AoE first, then supported scaling, defense, and draw. Remove obsolete basics only after replacements. Preserve health and potions for Kin; pursue useful cards rather than a fixed deck size.

rows.archetype: Provisional shiv scaling with efficient defense and selective draw
rows.summary: Build on existing shivs and Nunchaku without forcing completion. Add scaling and efficient defense, preserve AoE, heal before elites, and smith when safe. Remove obsolete Strikes after replacements; deck size is not a target.

rows.archetype: Shiv-supported burst with scaling damage and efficient defense
rows.summary: Heal before the forced elite. Prioritize scaling and efficient mitigation over more shiv supply. Keep the rest-heavy route, upgrade Echoing Slash when safe, and replace obsolete Strikes selectively. No calibrated damage gap is available.

rows.archetype: Relic-supported shiv burst with AoE cleanup and scaling defense
rows.summary: Upgrade AoE now and retain the two-fire route before Kin. Prioritize scaling and mitigation over additional shiv supply. Replace obsolete Strikes selectively; heal later when necessary. No calibrated damage gap is available.

rows.archetype: Relic-supported shiv burst with conditional Finale and reliable defense
rows.summary: Add draw, retention and defense around shiv relics and conditional Finale. Avoid speculative poison; remove obsolete Strikes selectively. Heal after the forced elite if needed; otherwise upgrade. The damage gap remains uncalibrated.
